parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组的ID，用于指定生命周期挂钩

parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_name

parameters.help_en:
The action to be performed after the wait state ends. Valid values: 

CONTINUE: continues the response to the scale-out or scale-in activity.
ABANDON: releases the ECS instances created during the scale-out activity, or removes the ECS instances from the scaling group during the scale-in activity.
ROLLBACK: rejects the release of ECS instances and rolls back the scale-in activity. For a scale-out activity, this value has the same effect as ABANDON, which releases the created ECS instances.

When a scale-in activity (SCALE_IN) occurs in a scaling group and multiple lifecycle hooks are triggered, if the `DefaultResult` of one lifecycle hook is set to `ABANDON` or `ROLLBACK`, the wait states of other lifecycle hooks are ended in advance when the wait state of this hook ends. In other cases, the next action is determined by the last lifecycle hook that ends its wait state
parameters.help_zh:
等待状态结束后的下一步动作，取值范围： 

CONTINUE：继续响应弹性扩张活动或者继续响应弹性收缩活动。
ABANDON：直接释放弹性扩张活动创建出来的ECS实例或者直接将弹性收缩活动中的ECS实例从伸缩组移除。

当伸缩组发生弹性收缩活动（SCALE_IN）并触发多个生命周期挂钩时，DefaultResult为ABANDON的生命周期挂钩触发的等待状态结束时，会提前将其它对应的等待状态提前结束。其他情况下，下一步动作均以最后一个结束等待状态的下一步动作为准
parameters.name: default_result

parameters.help_en:
The wait time set by the lifecycle hook for the scaling activity. The next action is performed after the wait state times out. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73846.html operation to extend the wait time of the ECS instance, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html operation to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩为伸缩组活动设置的等待时间，等待状态超时后会执行下一步动作。取值范围：30~21600，单位：秒。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73846.html延长ECS实例的等待时间，也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态
parameters.name: heartbeat_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The type of scaling activity to which the lifecycle hook applies. Valid values:
SCALE_OUT: scale-out activities of the scaling group.
SCALE_IN: scale-in activities of the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩适用的伸缩活动类型，取值范围：
SCALE_OUT：伸缩组弹性扩张活动。
SCALE_IN：伸缩组弹性收缩活动
parameters.name: lifecycle_transition

parameters.help_en:
The fixed string information for the wait state of the scaling activity. The value can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

When Auto Scaling pushes a message to the notification recipient, it also sends the predefined `NotificationMetadata` value to help you manage and mark different types of notifications. The `NotificationMetadata` parameter takes effect only when you also specify the `NotificationArn` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动的等待状态的固定字符串信息。参数长度不能超过4096个字符。

弹性伸缩每次推送消息到通知对象时，会同时发送您预先指定的NotificationMetadata参数值，便于管理和标记不同类别的通知信息。当您同时指定了NotificationArn参数时，NotificationMetadata参数方可生效
parameters.name: notification_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the notification recipient for the lifecycle hook. The following notification methods are supported when you set this parameter:
MNS queue. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.
OOS template. Format: `acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`.
EventBridge. Format: `acs:eventbridge:{region-id}:{account-id}:eventbus/default`.

Variables in the formats:
region-id: the ID of the region where the scaling group resides.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic.
templatename: the name of the OOS template
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：
消息服务MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
消息服务MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。
运维编排OOS模板，参数取值格式：`acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
region-id：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称。
templatename：OOS模板的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the lifecycle hook. Valid values:
Active: starts the lifecycle hook.
InActive: pauses the lifecycle hook.

If you do not set this parameter, the status of the lifecycle hook remains unchanged.
After a lifecycle hook is created, it is in the Active state by default
parameters.help_zh:
修改当前生命周期挂钩的状态，取值范围：
Active：表示启动生命周期挂钩。
InActive：表示暂停生命周期挂钩。

如果不设置该参数，则当前生命周期挂钩状态保持为原有状态
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_status

parameters.help_zh: 生命周期挂钩触发的具体场景
